title: {session}-baseline.json (working-tree baseline at step 8.0)
description: Captured by apex-baseline.sh. head_sha is the git rev-parse HEAD value at step 8.0 init. Consumed by step 9 (polish), step 11 (tail diff), step 12 (git stage filter), and step 13 (reflector diff context).

head_sha.description: Lowercase hex git commit sha (7-40 chars) recorded at step 8.0.

pre_dirty.description: Repo-relative paths dirty in the working tree at step 8.0 (tracked-modified UNION untracked-non-ignored). Computed via `(git diff --name-only HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard) | sort -u`. Step 12 excludes these from staging so user-pre-existing WIP is never bundled into the apex commit; step 13 reflector reads it for diff context.
